sql.joint_query:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admissions n JOIN admissions r ON n.scenario=r.scenario
          AND n.repository=r.repository AND n.source_commit=r.source_commit AND n.run_id=r.run_id
          AND n.attempt=r.attempt AND n.protocol_sha256=r.protocol_sha256 AND n.tar_sha256=r.tar_sha256
          JOIN admissions s ON n.scenario=s.scenario AND n.repository=s.repository AND n.source_commit=s.source_commit
          AND n.run_id=s.run_id AND n.attempt=s.attempt AND n.protocol_sha256=s.protocol_sha256 AND n.tar_sha256=s.tar_sha256
          WHERE n.scenario=? AND n.layer='artifact_numeric' AND r.layer='selected_read_gate' AND s.layer='retained_signed_identity'
          AND n.ok=1 AND r.ok=1 AND s.ok=1

status_interpretation: MET means the stated scoped positive layer is supported. UNRESOLVED includes unavailable evidence, a retained gate not passed, or a failed binding; it does not assert that the scientific claim or physical read is false.
